rationale: Adds a per-stage wall clock to the browser import lane (capture.mjs provenance.timings, import-timings.json) and skips the materialized document read for emits that never consume it. Measurement and an unconsumed artifact only; no captured value, lowering rule, or DesignIR output changes.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'browser CLI adapter attributes every lane stage in import-timings.json'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'browser lane clock laps are contiguous'
